description_expanded: Seaside Reunion - Luxury Home in 30A — Sleeps 46, Perfect for Large Groups & Beach Getaways Favorite Features: - Private Pool (Heat Available Oct-Apr) - Media and Game Room - Near Beach - ADA Accessible More About Seaside Reunion: Welcome to the ultimate 30A vacation experience, where luxury, space, and unforgettable memories come together. This expansive 21-bedroom venue is thoughtfully designed to comfortably sleep up to 46 guests in style and comfort, making it an ideal choice for large family vacations, multigenerational reunions, corporate retreats, wedding weekend stays, and special celebrations. From the moment you arrive, you’ll be captivated by the elegant coastal design, high-end finishes, and spacious layout that flows seamlessly throughout this stunning home. Each of the beautifully appointed bedrooms offers plenty of room to rest and recharge. Step outside to the showstopping centerpiece of this home—a private 20' × 60' pool oasis. Soak in the spa, bask on the tanning deck, or take a refreshing swim before unwinding poolside. With plenty of space to swim, play, relax, or entertain, this resort-style retreat is designed to be enjoyed year-round. Lounge poolside, take a refreshing swim, or gather with friends and family—your own private tropical escape is just steps from home. Spend joyful days and nights in the game room, with fun for all ages; cozy up by the inviting fireplace in the great room; or enjoy a blockbuster movie or big game in your media room — the perfect backdrop for group gatherings and shared experiences. Expansive living areas and multiple gathering spots make hosting memorable dinners, celebrations, and events simple and stress-free. Thoughtful touches like the in-home elevator ensure comfort and convenience for guests of all ages, while multiple outdoor decks and patios provide plenty of space to soak up the Florida sunshine and refreshing coastal breezes. Located just minutes from the sugar-white sands and emerald waters that make 30A one of Florida’s most desirable beach destinations, your home base puts you close to world-class beaches, boutique shopping, acclaimed dining, scenic bike trails, and a variety of coastal experiences. Explore charming nearby towns like Seaside, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and WaterColor — each with its own unique character and coastal charm. Whether you’re planning a relaxing retreat, an action-packed adventure, or a special event with friends and family, this exceptional estate offers the perfect blend of room to roam, luxury amenities, and unbeatable location. Book your stay today and give your guests the ultimate 30A coastal getaway they’ll be talking about for years!
